a.text: 'This world is the very last enemy that the knights shall face.'
'The cities should have stood still above the earth. Instead, they fed on their citizens' sweat and toil, and even began to creep their way forward.'
'The cities are living monsters. Now, gather everyone to rise up against these fortresses. Let us return to them the purest glory there is!'
'Let grassland be grassland again. Let sky be sky. Let the people be resolute once more. Let our glory last forever!'

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What's happening? Where are the campaign knights headed? The Adeptus?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: They went to the Wall of Champions exhibition hall, where the champions of years past are granted their awards and have their portraits displayed.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Why...? Shouldn't they be going after the government?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Board of Directors is discussing that right now. The way I see it, the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's trying to save face, and this is their first step.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: As for their next step... well... they might try to impose martial law with the garrison.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But in this day and age, things aren't going to be as simple as holding a knife to somebody's neck... The foolish knights haven't realized that.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The era of violence is long behind us.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Sorry, but you'll have to pay Area 0 another visit. The blackout will take a toll on the Infected shelter and treatment center.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: See if it's run into any problems.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Report, Mr. Spokesman. The power grid... is starting to recover! We're working to restart it now!
A silver ray of light makes its way through the darkness.
The extravagant appearance is surrounded by a boisterous audience.
The streetlights flicker, before the colorful neon lights start to rouse the city from its brief slumber.
The Silverlance Pegasus seems out of place against the backdrop of the neon billboards.
However, all those who are present: tumultuous passersby, the panicking knights, and the excited tourists...
All of them have the same misconception. They think the Pegasus is the source of the light.
And the city is slowly coming back to life behind them.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Grandmaster Ioleta.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: It's been a while, Liam.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: You've ventured far. Alas, it doesn't seem we have much time for rest.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: We don't need rest. There is nothing more urgent than cleaning up the filth for Kazimierz's sake.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Heh, look at you... Impatient as always.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Would you like to see tonight's main course?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Margaret Nearl...?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: She should not have refused your invitation. She could have been the finest among our ranks and avoided her fate.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Yet she's back in Kazimierz now, even stepping into that false arena... Did exile really change Margaret Nearl?

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: You fought her before. Do you think that's the kind of person she is?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Hmm... Time can change everything. It might have changed her too.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Look at the wall behind you, Liam. Look at the champions of Majors past.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Why do you think these knights of this slowly collapsing era shine so brilliantly, even now?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: An exceptional knight or two means nothing, Grandmaster.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: The knight competitions are still blasphemous and the root cause of Kazimierz's downfall.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Each of my journeys back to the Grand Knight Territory fill me with sorrow. Our people are losing respect, and our noble ideals have become a tired joke.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Perhaps... but that has always been the case since the campaign knights left the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Alas, the times belong to the young ones. Our conclusions no longer matter.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: So you too have realized as much, Doctor.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I should have expected no less.

options: We can't go too overboard right in the middle of Kazimierz.
My first priority is the safety of Amiya and all our operators.
None of you would want us to act rashly.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I understand... Nearl didn't want us to return to your side during the Major to begin with.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But I couldn't ignore the information I got from the local Infected. It was getting more and more dire by the minute... I thought I had to let you and Amiya know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, you made the right decision, Shining.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If the Infected are really facing... inhumane treatment in Area 0, then we can't stand idly by for the sake of our own 'safety.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Still... the Doctor's concerns are reasonable too... Kazimierz, Ursus, and Lungmen are all different...

options: We could bomb the facility now, rescue all the Infected, and skip town.
We could talk to the General Chamber and buy out all the remaining Infected.
We could report this to the National Council, and let the Adeptus handle things.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Violence is out of the question.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we cross that line, Kazimierz has the power to knock us over in a split second.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're in the dead center of the Grand Knight Territory. This country might be fundamentally different from Ursus, but... this is still a nation of knights.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter how intense its internal conflicts have gotten, this is still Kazimierz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island can't make an enemy of this place.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Uhh... W-We probably can't do that...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if we could buy all the Infected with money... what happens after that? You think the people of the Grand Knight Territory will just stop getting infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Besides, that would only turn the Infected into a commodity.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that wouldn't solve anything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi... We still don't know the whole truth of Area 0.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi and the K.G.C.C. are not on the best of terms, and the Adeptus's attitude towards the Infected is ambiguous at best... It's possible they've been tolerating them right from the start.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If that really is the case... what could Rhodes Island do?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: What will you do?

options: We'll solve their problems their way.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Over there! After her!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (The power's back already... Knowing Sona, she'll find a way to rendezvous.)

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Call for backup right now—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Turn the corner here—Nng!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Just as I'm enjoying my time lounging around Area 0... the lights go off on me.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I almost got the impression the Armorless Union was finally so stingy they stopped paying their checkpoints' power bills. Up until I got the backup request, that is.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Platinum...!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You again...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: This really makes me wish you and Flametail Knight got a harder beating last time.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Too bad... harder I'm beat, the harder I fight back.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Now out of the way—!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You never learn, do you...? Guess I'll have to teach you another lesson.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (She's keeping her distance—As long as I block her shot, I'll have a chance to return her attack!)

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: She's here! Help Platinum!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (Crap! Behind me—?!)

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Ngh...! Did she shatter the streetlight?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What if the shards cut my face? Sheesh...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Justyna!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Ashlock, get out of there.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: We'll hold her back somehow.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Don't even think about it!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Grr... what a pain. Let me take cover first. I'll find you...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: A standard-issue light crossbow doesn't have that range...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: No, are there two of them—?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Fartooth, looks like she's on to me.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Time to move, then.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Never get into a sniper war with the Armorless. Then again... It's two-on-one right now.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (They stopped... Did they change positions? Smart.)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (If I'd known this would be such a pain, I would've ignored the call for backup...)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Still...)
Platinum closes her eyes.
She thinks back to something her parents told her long ago.
They told her that her sharp eyes would bring honor and glory to the family.
Has she found glory yet?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I got you now, Szewczyk.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Urgh—?!
An arrow brushes past Szewczyk's face, fierce as a windstorm.
A few centimeters' difference and his brain would be torn to pieces.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: —She's fighting from such a distance?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Talk to me, Szewczyk!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Dammit! Don't stop! Keep moving!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hnn—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: This arrow's a present for you... Merry Christmas.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Special arrowheads... And they go hard.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: She can pin down our positions even in complex urban terrain like this?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: They're gone...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Did they get away?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I'm not one to run like that, Platinum.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You... What did you do to my family?!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: What did you do to them?!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You realized you can't fight me at range, so you're making this a melee?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Good thinking.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Ngh—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Pathetic... A father ending up like this because he crossed the Armorless Union.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You little—!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I didn't kill your wife and child.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: —Where are you hiding them?!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: If you just did what the Armorless Union wanted, I could get you on the phone with them..

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You want me to betray Pinus Sylvestris?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Are you a father... or are you a knight?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Do you have to go so far for the Infected, Szewczyk?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: That's as far as you go, Platinum... At this range, your reflexes are no match for my bolts.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Make your choice.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Grr...

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: None of you... give a damn about us knights...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Anyone can become a knight by joining the competitions. It's easier if you're born into knight nobility, though, yeah.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The knighthood... is kind of just a disappointing dream.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Tch...!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: —Is pride more important than your family?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I was never going to trust you anyway, you dirty assassin!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Do it, Fartooth!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Looks like order has returned to the streets.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: That was a huge ruckus...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Did Sona and her friends do all that?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Perhaps... there are others fanning the flames.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Their hearts are filled with anger. They want to rise up against their unfair treatment, and the Infected's fight... will end up exploited by another party for another purpose.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've seen tragedies like this time and again.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Are you thinking about helping them?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Your choice is between fighting for the Infected and fighting as a knight. Those choices couldn't be more mutually exclusive these days—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: —The injustice that the Infected face is just the tip of the iceberg. Suffering takes more forms than our eyes can see.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I believe there will be those who will uphold justice for the Infected, and I trust that they will achieve just that.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But it's not up to us to rescue them. It'll all be meaningless if they find themselves rescued by those who already have a firm conviction.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: A rare visitor.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: It's been some time, Sir Młynar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Don't 'Sir' me. You're the only knight here.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If you're here for Margaret, I'm afraid you'll be disappointed.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: It has been years since I last came back to the Grand Knight Territory. I am shocked to find our hero's estate... in this shape.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Have the sisters moved out?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: My apologies... That is your family issue.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Was there something else...?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Sir Młynar—

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Stop calling me that.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Others may look down on you, but we will not.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Even if Margaret strayed onto the wrong path and her younger sister is still young, the Nearl family didn't earn our respect riding on a legacy of fame.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: The boastful merchants have not realized this fundamental idea, and that is why they do not understand the actions that knights take.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: And, truly, just seeing you in good health eases my mind.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You mean my appearance? Spare me the pleasantries, sir.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If you truly have any respect for me, please leave.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Sir Młynar.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: We have the utmost respect for you... no, for the Nearl family.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The age of heroes is long behind us...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Does a mere citizen of Kazimierz like me really deserve such respect from a Silverlance Pegasus?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What a bizarre evening, Doctor...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It'll be daybreak soon. I'm sorry I couldn't come sooner. The K.G.C.C. has a lot on its hands, after all...

options: Tell me your thoughts on Area 0.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'd like to think... there's no hidden meaning in that question.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You are a clever one.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Do you think that... the way the Grand Knight Territory treats its Infected is a reasonable measure?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You don't need to answer me. Both you and I know the answer—It's only a compromise.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: We could neither make the perfect, humane solution nor bring ourselves to go with the bloody, primitive answer, and this is the result.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm not sure if you've noticed, but our society today is built on top of all kinds of unreasonable things. You might want to poke through our history books a little.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You may not know this... but after the nation of pegasi was overthrown in the upheaval wrought by the Nightzmora and this country of knights came to be, it was the affinities who actually banded together first.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The affinities toiled away for the knights' profits and tended their lands. Then, they came together, and chased the tyrannical knights off the stage.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: And now? The K.G.C.C. controls both a hitman agency and the competition knights, and those who are being controlled will always try to rise up and break free of tyranny—

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: History repeats itself, Doctor.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The spokesman before me had some dirty dealings too. He paid the price for them, and now it's my turn to step into this position, pressing forward no matter how hard the job.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Does all this fit your concept of morality? Is it 'reasonable?'

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I don't know how you've come to know this, but you've no doubt already noticed...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The way the General Chamber has decided to deal with those who get injured in the arena, those whose Oripathy has progressed beyond control... is to put them out of their misery.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Is it unreasonable? Of course. I want to tell them 'no' myself.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But do we have to keep treating those Oripathy patients, when this disease is incurable?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Each day that Oripathy remains incurable is yet another day where coexistence is out of reach.

options: What you're talking about is murder.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Everyone who found it unreasonable has been eliminated, creating this thoroughly reasonable history. Fortunately, I've accepted this truth. You understand me, don't you?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You're trying to take on Kazimierz... and I suggest you stop.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: We may have other options, and if you can think of anything, I'll be more than willing to help.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But not right now.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The prime suspect in last night's blackout is none other than the Infected knights.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Let's suppose the blackout caused a traffic accident... or an elderly person who relies on a ventilator stopped breathing because of it—

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Will we have to turn a blind eye to tragedies like these in the name of helping the Infected?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Allowing the Infected to participate in the competitions in large numbers has been a source of stress to everyone—

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: And this stress comes not from some organization or people out there. It comes from society itself, Doctor.

options: But the Infected are dying as we speak, and we are doing nothing about it.
You're right. 'We may have other options.'

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: There are many people dying of unnatural causes right this moment. Disease, Catastrophe. We can't help everyone.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: True...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If you have an idea... I'm sure you'll get it done.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But please remember what I just said. Don't treat this whole affair like you're helping the elderly cross the street.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The contradictions that persist in Area 0 are complicated.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Sorry... Perhaps I've gone too far with my words.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It'll benefit the both of us if you could calm down and think all this over, carefully.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Someone here to see you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'll get out of your way...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: And don't get the wrong idea... If possible, I would like to be on your side.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: That said, it's difficult to find the one best answer out of all the unreasonable things we can do nothing about.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You're right... The blackout, the Radiant Knight, and the Blood Knight... It all fueled the Infected knights' will to resist.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Before everything gets out of hand, I hope both you and I can keep casualties... to a minimum.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: 'Goodness pays off,' or so it's often said, but I'm afraid this no longer holds true in our society. Unless, that is, you reach out and grab hold of the payoff yourself.
